en: The image shows a colorized postcard featuring a dramatic riverside cliff (the Schäferwand, also called the 'sleeping shepherd'), topped with a small building (possibly a villa or lookout). Below the cliff, there is a row of elegant 19th-century townhouses and a steamboat on the river. The setting is picturesque, with a forest atop the cliff and a peaceful riverbank town. The text is in German and identifies the location as 'Bodenbach a. E.'
